verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs point developers to generating their own client libraries for Java, Python, Node.js and other languages from an official OpenAPI v3 spec. This is the same spec Yapily uses internally, but it is a self-generate route rather than maintained, first-party SDKs. The probe could not find the spec at common docs paths, though that does not show the documented spec is missing. Missing for 10: official pre-built and maintained SDK packages, published package or registry links, a confirmed OpenAPI download location, and independent or hands-on proof that generated clients work.
